summary: Iteration 14 tested backend and frontend for four new features: privacy notice, driver trip history, dispatcher notes and stop proof (odometer + photo). Backend: 16 of 17 pytest checks pass. The one failure is minor: a non-numeric id returns 500. Driver app at 390x844, light and dark: the privacy notice shows on first launch, the policy link opens https://driverapp.startechsolutions.us/privacy, and the notice does not come back after Got it and a reload. Trip History works: 44.0 mi and 9 trips, thumbnails load through blob auth, and the viewer opens and closes. The NotesCard on Active Trip shows notes, a note sent from the dashboard appeared live over the socket, and Got it removes it. The arrive panel works: invalid odometer is rejected, Cancel works, a photo can be attached, and confirming shows 'Arrived · 20020 mi · photo'. Dashboard at 1920x1080, light and dark: the Note modal works (chips fill the input, Send is disabled when empty, the sent note is listed with Seen / Not seen yet). The Stops board card and the StopsModal both show 'Odometer 20020 mi' and the photo thumbnail. One integration gap: the 'Seen' status in an open NotesModal does not update live after the driver taps Got it. Deprecated packages: none checked this round (none found in iteration 13).

minor.issue: A non-numeric id (for example 'abc') returns 500 ('Failed to update note' / 'Failed to fetch notes' / 'Failed to send note') because Postgres rejects the integer cast. It should return 400 or 404. Validate with Number.isInteger before querying.

The multer fileFilter silently drops non-image files. The arrival is then recorded with no photo and no error. The stop odometer is also not checked against the trip's start odometer, so a reading lower than the start is accepted.

integration_issues.issue: The backend emits 'notes:changed' to the dashboard room when a driver acknowledges a note, but nothing in web-dashboard/src listens for it (grep finds no matches). With the modal open, the driver acknowledged note 4 and the modal still showed 'Not seen yet' 3 seconds later. It updates only when the modal is reopened.

issues: privacy-notice-policy shows a browser focus outline box when the modal opens. This is cosmetic, comes from react-native-web auto-focus, and does not affect native.

action_items: Subscribe to the 'notes:changed' socket event in NotesModal (or Drivers page) and reload notes when driverId matches, so 'Seen' updates live
Return 400 for non-numeric :id / :noteId in notesController (sendDriverNote, getDriverNotes, markMyNoteRead) instead of 500
Optional: reject non-image arrival photos with a 400 instead of silently dropping; consider warning if stop odometer < trip startOdometer
Optional: clear module-level notes cache (services/notes.ts `current`) on logout so a different driver on the same device never briefly sees previous driver's notes
critical_code_review_comments: notesController: markMyNoteRead scopes the update by driverId, so another driver cannot acknowledge James's note. Verified: Maria's call left the note unread.
files.ts driverOwns: verified Maria gets 403 on James's stop photo and on another driver's trip photo, and gets 200 on her own. A path traversal attempt returned 403.
StopsCard ArriveButton offline message says the arrival 'is recorded when you end the trip', but the optional odometer and photo entered in the panel are lost in that path.
getDriverTrips without days returns no photos and at most 10 trips. With days=30 it includes photos and a limit of 200. Both verified.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ notes for James (ids 2, 3, 4), all acknowledged; note 1 'Test note' is left unread. Created TEST_ trip 30 for James, now cancelled because there is no delete endpoint. Created TEST_ stops 45-49, all cleared. Michael's trip was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use r14_setup.py: 'setup' starts a TEST_ trip for James and adds 2 stops at 33.4497,-111.9464; 'note <msg>' sends a note; 'ack <prefix>' acknowledges a note as James; 'cleanup' cancels the active trip and clears stops. In the driver app the Home and ActiveTrip screens are both mounted, so testIDs appear twice; use the '>> visible=true' selector. Set Playwright geolocation to the stop coordinates before tapping Confirm arrival. The web ImagePicker opens a file chooser, so use expect_file_chooser. Skip the privacy notice with add_init_script localStorage 'privacyNoticeSeen:v1'. Set dashboard dark mode with localStorage 'theme'='dark'.
rca_of_issue: Seen status is not live: notesController emits io.to('dashboard').emit('notes:changed', {driverId}) in markMyNoteRead and sendDriverNote, but web-dashboard/src has no socket.on('notes:changed') handler, and NotesModal only calls load() on mount and after send.
